# Abilities Detected by "Has Status"

Source: [2698](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/2698); edited 2024-08-31. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-2698-n1"></a>

- The retained matrix maps Has Status results to abilities. Source-reported verification uses import code YFPB7.

<a id="wiki-2698-n2"></a>

- Respawn areas are documented as Phased Out; Accretion and Earthshatter as both Knocked Down and Stunned; Blizzard as Stunned.

<a id="wiki-2698-n3"></a>

- Configuration: Artillery and Rip Tire are documented as not Rooted despite immobilization.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/2698.md).

Source limitations:

- Matrix is date-sensitive and asks contributors to correct ability changes; game code and behavior not retested.
